Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environment plate behind animated SD characters in a mobile side-view battle arena. Generate one full-bleed wide 16:9 landscape, preferably 1920x1080 or larger. No characters. Camera at low side-view battle height, NOT top-down map. An open level clearing spans the ENTIRE lower 32 percent edge-to-edge, supporting a hero on the left and five small enemies on the right. No trees, bushes, rocks, crystals, pools or tall grass in this foreground fighting zone. Ground gently textured with low contrast, readable feet. Forest scenery starts BEHIND the fighting zone. Rich atmospheric layered background in upper two thirds, quiet center. Keep center crop functional at mobile aspect ratios. Use attached images as style/composition references ONLY: image 1 forest identity and foliage colors, image 2 open horizontal battle floor composition, do not copy the sky islands. Soft upper-left light. No text, letters, numbers, UI, markers, logos, borders, watermark, characters, creatures, pixel art, photorealism, 3D toy rendering, horror, gore, gritty darkness, excessive bloom or visual noise.
Scene: World 4 ILLUSION FOREST, ordinary stages 1 through 9. Enchanting lilac and violet forest clearing, great graceful twisting trunks at far sides, arching plum-purple foliage overhead, layered lavender woodland depth. Subtle translucent duplicated tree silhouettes in the distant background suggest a harmless magical mirage. Small polished mint and violet crystals among mossy roots only BEHIND the fighting zone, a few dreamy glow motes in upper background. Soft pearly lavender haze, glints of warm dappled light. Broad unobstructed pale mauve earth floor, almost horizontal, no winding path occupying the battle floor. Mysterious, luminous and inviting, clearly a forest, not candyland.
